overloadMerges.note: childElemName and childElemValue are filled/returned params (docs: '<-' direction); autoparse defaults all params to direction:in. Also adds jointConstraint reflecting the doc syntax's nested optional (childElemValue can only be passed together with childElemName).

params.name: childElemName
params.description: Receives the name of the last child element

params.name: childElemValue
params.description: Receives the value of the last child element

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Returns a reference to the last child of an XML element, usable for further DOM navigation, and optionally its name and value.

jointConstraints.rule: childElemValue can only be passed if childElemName is also passed (the syntax nests childElemValue inside childElemName's optional group).
